recognize_zh: 周邊血片中央一顆大小正常的嗜中性球，細胞核只分成兩個圓形小葉，中間以細絲相連（像夾鼻眼鏡，pince-nez），染色質粗糙濃縮，細胞質顆粒正常，這是 Pelger-Huët 異常的典型型態。
features: Normal-sized neutrophil with a bilobed nucleus
Two round, symmetric lobes joined by a thin chromatin filament (pince-nez configuration)
Normal pink cytoplasm with fine neutrophilic granules, no hypogranularity
Background red cells normocytic and normochromic with central pallor
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil with a bilobed nucleus composed of two round lobes connected by a thin filament, in a pince-nez configuration. The chromatin is coarse and clumped, indicating nuclear maturity, and the cytoplasm is normally granulated. The surrounding red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with Pelger-Huët anomaly; the inherited form shows this change in most neutrophils with normal granulation, whereas acquired (pseudo-) Pelger-Huët change should be excluded.

ddx.vs: Acquired forms affect a subset of neutrophils and are usually accompanied by cytoplasmic hypogranularity, other dysplasia, and cytopenias.

ddx.dx: Drug-induced pseudo-Pelger change (e.g., mycophenolate, tacrolimus, valproate)
ddx.vs: Morphology can be identical, so it is separated by medication history and reversal after drug withdrawal.
Band forms have a curved, unsegmented nucleus of uniform width with less clumped chromatin, rather than two round lobes with coarse chromatin.
Eosinophils are also often bilobed but contain abundant large orange-red granules.
